title: Qualitative Editorial Memory Schema
description: Maintains temporal and historical context of recent editorial decisions without arbitrary time windows or numerical thresholds.

tracked_dimensions.recent_cut_density: Qualitative perception of recent edit pace (e.g., calm, balanced, rapid) across recent beats.
tracked_dimensions.recent_visual_activity: Qualitative level of on-screen motion, camera movement, or graphical changes in recent moments.
tracked_dimensions.recent_technique_history: Ordered list of recent technique types applied to avoid unwanted repetitive patterns.
tracked_dimensions.recent_stimulus_intensity: Cumulative qualitative cognitive load from text overlays, audio punches, and framing shifts.
tracked_dimensions.used_assets: Catalogue of B-roll takes and graphic elements already displayed to prevent unintentional asset reuse.

memory_principles: No fixed duration windows or cut quotas are binding.
Memory serves as qualitative awareness to balance rhythm and prevent visual fatigue.
Repetition avoidance is contextual rather than strictly numerical.
